instruction: Locate every slide in the presentation with the word 'Questions' and compile their contents into a file named 'question_slides.docx' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

keywords: What questions do you have so far?
